content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Pepper Chicken",
  "ingredients": [
    "1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs",
    "2 large onions, chopped",
    "2 cloves of garlic, minced",
    "2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger",
    "1 teaspoon ground black pepper",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional)",
    "2 tablespoons butter or oil",
    "2 cups mixed bell peppers (green, red, yellow, orange)",
    "1 tablespoon soy sauce (optional)",
    "1 tablespoon tomato ketchup (optional)",
    "Chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Heat 1 tablespoon of butter or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.",
      "time": "2 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a large skillet to cook the chicken and peppers."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 3-4 minutes.",
      "time": "3-4 minutes",
      "tip": "Stir occasionally to prevent burning."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Be careful not to burn the garlic."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.",
      "time": "5-6 minutes",
      "tip": "Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165\u00b0F (74\u00b0C)."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Add the mixed bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 3-4 minutes.",
      "time": "3-4 minutes",
      "tip": "Stir occasionally to prevent burning."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Add the ground black pepper, salt, and cayenne pepper (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Adjust the seasoning to taste."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "If using soy sauce and tomato ketchup, add them to the skillet and stir to combine.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "These ingredients are optional, but add flavor to the dish."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot over rice or noodles.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Serve immediately and enjoy!"
    }
  ]
}
how much chicken will it take to serve 2 people for this

For the Pepper Chicken recipe, you'll need about 3/4 to 1 pound of boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs to serve 2 people. This assumes a serving size of about 1/2 to 3/4 cup of cooked chicken per person.
